correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, the proof establishes a nonempty positive interval from Ivanov equality plus compactness; a Plucker minor >=sqrt(2/3) forces containment of all remaining projected generators in its centered parallelogram, so area=2p. Large minors are disjoint by Cauchy–Binet. A Haar minor is Beta(1,n-2), proved from two independent spherical beta factors by Gamma duplication and moment determinacy. iid extreme-value and mean follow by exact near-endpoint survival and uniform integrability. Standard-library check.py executed successfully on 96,000 random planes and 136,035 diagnostics; finite computations support, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The near-maximum distribution of the planar shadow area of a canonical n-dimensional regular polytope is a natural stochastic geometric invariant. The theorem gives an exact, rather than asymptotic, nonempty interval with the correct exponent and all-dimensional explicit coefficient and derives the sharp best-of-N Weibull normalization and mean. This is not obtainable by a routine table lookup, a finite count, or deterministic maximization alone.
